name: Willow Chompski
source: Playful and cheerful Willow is Gordon's daughter and his assistant in the Chompski shop. Thanks to her fairy talents, she is able to travel between worlds and find rare ingredients to sell. This has doubled the shop's profits and made her father very proud.
translation: Playful and cheerful Willow is Gordon's daughter and his assistant in the Chompski shop. Thanks to her fairy talents, she is able to travel between worlds and find rare ingredients to sell. This has doubled the shop's profits and made her father very proud.
